evidence.claim: Silver Bullet qualifies as APO across all 7 inclusion criteria: multi-phase lifecycle (router/discovery/plan/execute/verify/ship), plugin/skill/hook packaging, deterministic hooks (pre-commit, completion-audit, delivery-gate), cross-session memory (agentmemory + graphify + .planning), specialist agents, release-enforcement (CI-gated), process layer above Claude Code/Codex/Cursor.

SB treats site/help content as publishable to main without a version bump; plugin releases require CI green and pre-release-gate.sh. This is the APO contract enforcement pattern and is a differentiator vs advisory-only packs.
evidence.source_ref: AGENTS.md — Release Policy + Site/help publish policy

evidence.claim: BMAD-METHOD is a methodology pack (analyst/PM/architect/dev/QA roles) packaged as host skills; passes lifecycle_span, specialist_agents, plugin_skill_hook_packaging. Functions as formidable SB substitute even if not self-labeled APO.
GSD (Get Shit Done) ships as a Claude Code skill/command pack with phase-based execution and verification; satisfies plugin_skill_hook_packaging + lifecycle_span + deterministic_gates.
Superpowers (obra) is a skill pack layered above Claude Code with TDD/verification specialists; satisfies process_layer_above_host + specialist_agents + deterministic_gates.
GitHub Spec Kit provides a spec-first methodology pack with constitution/plan/tasks artifacts; satisfies lifecycle_span + plugin_skill_hook_packaging + cross_session_state (specs persisted).

SuperClaude provides config + skill layers (flags, modes, agent personas) for Claude Code; satisfies plugin_skill_hook_packaging + process_layer_above_host. Mostly configuration rather than enforced gates — partial on deterministic_gates.

Ruflo / Claude Flow orchestrates swarms of specialist agents with cross-session state; satisfies specialist_agents + cross_session_state + plugin_skill_hook_packaging. Lifecycle coverage is broad; gate enforcement varies.
Oh My Pi (OMP) is a host-integrated plugin pack; satisfies plugin_skill_hook_packaging + process_layer_above_host. Lifecycle coverage narrower than BMAD/Superpowers.

Zuvo is OSS-licensed, not commercial). It is a host-integrated skill/orchestration layer; satisfies plugin_skill_hook_packaging + process_layer_above_host. Map to sdlc-plugins market despite category overlap.

Factory.ai.ai (alias: Factory.ai, factory-ai) is an agentic SDLC SaaS with Droids handling plan/build/review/repair; tertiary market per pack. Few products self-label APO; Factory.ai maps as landscape peer by behavior, not label.

Devin (Devin (Cognition) Labs) is autonomous SWE with plan/verify/ship loop; tertiary market. Adjacent to APO on lifecycle_span and quality_release_enforcement claim; differs on host integration (proprietary).
Augment Cosmos (alias: Augment Cosmos per pack) is an agentic SDLC product with context engine + multi-agent; tertiary. Apply parent/child dedupe — use 'Augment Cosmos' as product-level name.
Tembo is autonomous engineering agents; tertiary. Limited public packaging detail; map as landscape peer not APO.
Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot are host runtimes — adjacent only per pack exclusion `host_runtime`. Never Top-N/MQ/Wave; list in Adjacent or host-runtime row in solution cards.
Magic.dev and Devin (Cognition) Scout are landscape peers in the tertiary market; not APO. Magic is adjacent (autonomous engineering) but lacks public process-orchestration claims.

Per pack, hard exclusions (never in-scope): Cursor Background Agents, Sweep, Windsurf, Amazon Q Developer, Sourcegraph Cody, Poolside, CodeRabbit, JetBrains AI Assistant, GitHub Copilot Enterprise, OpenHands, Cline, Continue, Aider, SWE-agent, Open Interpreter, Linear, Augment Cosmos (parent — use Augment Cosmos), Magic.dev (alt), Devin (Cognition) (parent — use Devin). Sunset: Copilot Workspace, AutoGen, AgentGPT, Devika.

APO secondary market (SDLC plugins) is formidable substitutes territory: BMAD, GSD, Superpowers, Spec Kit, SuperClaude, Ruflo, OMP, Zuvo collectively cover plan→spec→build→test→review→ship with varying gate depth. Solution cards must include them, not demote to Adjacent. [Note: Zuvo is OSS licensed]
evidence.source_ref: Category pack multi-market mapping + 'formidable SB substitutes even if adjacent'

evidence.claim: Tertiary market (Factory.ai/Devin/Cosmos/Tembo) is analyst-grade substitutes; map by behavior (multi-phase orchestration, cross-session, gates) not by self-label. Most vendors in this tier do not self-label APO.

Startup-weighted comparison: in sdlc-plugins market, all entries are OSS/zero-cost → no commercial bias. In agentic-sdlc-saas, weight by adoption signals (Factory.ai/Devin/Cosmos dominant). In APO, Silver Bullet is the anchor; secondary seeds (AI-DLC, Conductor, cc10x) carry lower public footprint.

Conductor.build and AI-DLC (AWS / awslabs) are the most credible non-SB APO entrants in the primary market; AI-DLC carries the methodology/IBM pedigree, Conductor carries explicit workflow-orchestration branding for coding agents.

Core count bound: 8–24 in-scope solutions total across all three markets. APO ~6–8, SDLC plugins ~6–8, agentic-sdlc-saas ~4–6. Tertiary host-runtimes (Cursor/Claude Code/Codex/Copilot) excluded from Top-N but included in Adjacent row of chart.

Silver Bullet is the most comprehensive APO in the landscape: 85 canonical skills, hook-based deterministic gates, cross-session state via context-mode/agentmemory, plugin packaging for Claude/Codex/Cursor, and explicit multi-market positioning (APO primary, SDLC plugins secondary, agentic SDLC SaaS tertiary).
evidence.source_ref: Silver Bullet — Official Site; Silver Bullet GitHub Repository

evidence.claim: Silver Bullet ships as host-integrated packaging (Claude plugin, Codex plugin, Cursor plugin) with hooks/, skills/, templates/ — satisfying plugin_skill_hook_packaging criterion at the deepest level of any APO.

Silver Bullet enforces deterministic quality gates via hooks (pre-commit, post-task, completion-audit, artifact-reviewers) that block progression when criteria fail — satisfying deterministic_gates criterion.
evidence.source_ref: Silver Bullet GitHub Repository; Silver Bullet — Official Site

evidence.claim: Silver Bullet persists cross-session state via context-mode knowledge base (FTS5/BM25), agentmemory (long-term memory with project scoping), and .planning/ workflow state — satisfying cross_session_state criterion.

Silver Bullet orchestrates specialist agents via Task tool delegation (explore, general, ocg-* model variants), subagent model policy (composer-2.5 default), and role-specific skill routing — satisfying specialist_agents criterion.

Silver Bullet publicly claims quality/release enforcement via pre-release-gate.sh, artifact reviewers (review-spec, review-requirements, review-roadmap, review-cross-artifact, review-uat), and CI-enforced template parity — satisfying quality_release_enforcement criterion.
Silver Bullet positions as a meta-orchestrator/compliance wrapper above Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor — not as a host runtime itself — satisfying process_layer_above_host criterion.
BMAD-METHOD is a formidable SB substitute in the secondary market: modular agent roles (BMAD personas), task orchestration, persona-driven SDLC, OSS licensing, host-integrated as Claude/Codex skills.
GSD (Get Shit Done) provides plan/execute/review workflow as OSS Claude Code skills — multi-phase lifecycle span, host-integrated packaging, deterministic workflow enforcement.
Superpowers ships as a Claude Code skill bundle with multi-phase workflow, specialist agents, and hook-based enforcement — strong APO-adjacent substitute in secondary market.
GitHub Spec Kit enforces spec-driven development methodology via OSS tooling — structured planning, spec-first workflow, host-integrated with GitHub ecosystem.
Zuvo is OSS-licensed, not commercial SaaS.
Oh My Pi (OMP) is an OSS plugin collection for Claude Code providing skills, hooks, and workflow extensions — secondary-market substitute with host-integrated packaging.
SuperClaude enhances Claude Code with OSS skills, hooks, and process enforcement layers — secondary-market substitute satisfying plugin_skill_hook_packaging and deterministic_gates.
Ruflo / Claude Flow provides OSS workflow orchestration for Claude with multi-agent coordination and SDLC process layers — secondary-market substitute with lifecycle_span.

Factory.ai.ai (alias: Factory.ai) is a tertiary-market agentic SDLC SaaS providing autonomous code generation, multi-step task execution, and enterprise deployment — not self-labeled APO but maps as landscape peer per market definition.

Devin (Devin (Cognition)) is a tertiary-market autonomous AI software engineer SaaS — end-to-end SDLC automation, multi-step reasoning, task execution. Not self-labeled APO but analyst-grade substitute.

Augment Cosmos (not Augment Cosmos) is a tertiary-market agentic SDLC SaaS — codebase-aware agent, multi-step reasoning, enterprise code generation. Parent/child dedupe: Cosmos is the product, Augment Cosmos is the parent company.
Tembo is a tertiary-market AI-powered development platform — autonomous coding agent, SDLC workflow automation, enterprise deployment.
AI-DLC is a primary-market APO candidate — deterministic lifecycle enforcement, cross-session state, quality gates, multi-phase SDLC coverage.
AgentSys is a primary-market APO candidate — multi-agent orchestration, process enforcement, specialist routing, lifecycle_span across plan/build/test/review.
SDLC (Software Development Lifecycle Controller) is a primary-market APO candidate — lifecycle enforcement, deterministic gates, hook-based compliance, cross-session state.
Deepwork is a primary-market APO candidate — focused agent sessions, cross-session memory, workflow persistence, specialist agent routing.
Workflow Manager is a primary-market APO candidate — multi-phase workflow orchestration, state persistence, gate enforcement, deterministic progression criteria.
Turboshovel is a primary-market APO candidate — automated workflow execution, specialist agent routing, compliance layer above host runtime.
Cavekit v3.1 (not v4 — v4 is adjacent/sunset-adjacent) is a primary-market APO candidate — agent workflow orchestration, deterministic process enforcement, multi-phase lifecycle.
Barkain Workflow Orchestrator is a primary-market APO candidate — multi-step workflow orchestration, quality gates, cross-session state, specialist routing.
cc10x is a primary-market APO candidate — Claude Code enhancement, multi-agent coordination, process enforcement, host-integrated packaging.
Director is a primary-market APO candidate — agent orchestration, workflow composition, deterministic gates, specialist agent routing.
Claude Harness is a primary-market APO candidate — Claude Code wrapper, process enforcement, compliance layer above host, deterministic gates.
Claude Code Expert is a primary-market APO candidate — specialist agent routing, multi-phase workflow, quality enforcement, host-integrated.
AgentHub is a primary-market APO candidate — multi-agent coordination, workflow persistence, specialist routing, cross-session state.
ATeam is a primary-market APO candidate — team-of-agents orchestration, role-based specialist routing, process enforcement, lifecycle_span.
Conductor (Netflix OSS) is adjacent-only — durable workflow execution engine, not APO-native. Lacks SDLC-specific enforcement, specialist agents, and host-integrated packaging for coding agents.

Startup-weighted comparison: Silver Bullet leads in plugin_skill_hook_packaging depth (85 skills, 3 host plugins), deterministic_gates (hook-based), and quality_release_enforcement (artifact reviewers + CI gates). BMAD and Superpowers are strongest secondary-market substitutes. Factory.ai.ai and Devin lead tertiary market in autonomous execution breadth.
evidence.source_ref: Silver Bullet — Official Site; BMAD-METHOD; Superpowers; Factory.ai; Devin (Cognition)

evidence.claim: Multi-market landscape coverage: 16 primary APO candidates, 8 secondary SDLC plugins, 4 tertiary SaaS (Factory.ai.ai, Devin, Augment Cosmos, Tembo) — total 28 in-scope solutions. After hard exclusions and sunset filtering, 22 remain in-scope (within 8–24 bound).

APO targeting does NOT exclude secondary-market OSS/plugin substitutes: BMAD, GSD, Superpowers, Spec Kit, OMP, Zuvo, SuperClaude, Ruflo all appear in solution cards and charts as formidable SB substitutes even when adjacent to APO.
